carouselContent.title: Cordyceps
carouselContent.description: **Boosts** energy. Enhances oxygen use. Supports recovery. Adapts you to stress.

expandedContent.content:
Cordyceps does its thing through **four key compounds**.

**Cordycepin** *boosts* ATP and mimics adenosine, so you get real energy and better endurance.
***Polysaccharides*** support your immune system and overall vitality.
__Adenosine__ helps your body manage energy and improves oxygen flow.
And ~~sterols~~ and `peptides` calm inflammation and build stress resilience.

Put it all together, and you've got a natural way to fuel your cells, breathe easier, and bounce back stronger.

carouselContent.title: Raw Cacao
carouselContent.description: **Elevates** mood. Rich in antioxidants. Boosts focus. Natural energy without the crash.

expandedContent.content:
Raw cacao is nature's ultimate **mood enhancer** and **brain fuel**.

**Theobromine** provides sustained energy and gentle stimulation without jitters or crashes.
***Flavonoids*** protect your brain from oxidative stress and support cognitive function.
__Phenylethylamine__ (PEA) naturally elevates mood and enhances focus.
And **anandamide** — the 'bliss molecule' — promotes feelings of happiness and well-being.

Raw cacao also contains magnesium for muscle function and iron for energy transport. It's like having a natural antidepressant and nootropic rolled into one delicious superfood.
